title: Service Contracts: shortfall assessment figures by tier
content:
## Scope
This reference covers the per-tier figures behind the minimum quantity commitment shortfall (dead freight) of an Aurelia Hanse Line (AHL) Service Contracts contract: when the shortfall is assessed, the tolerance inside which nothing is charged, the dead freight rate, the quarterly carryover, the smallest assessment that is booked and the payment period.

## Assessment timing and charging
| Tier | Assessment basis | Tolerance (% of the commitment assessed) | Dead freight (USD per FEU beyond tolerance) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | at term end | 0 | 450.00 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | at term end | 5 | 400.00 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | at term end | 5 | 350.00 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | quarterly prorated, with a term-end true-up | 10 | 300.00 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | quarterly prorated, with a term-end true-up | 10 | 250.00 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | quarterly prorated, with a term-end true-up | 15 | 200.00 |

## Carryover, minimum assessment and payment
| Tier | Quarterly carryover (% of the quarterly commitment) | Minimum assessment booked (USD per assessment) | Payment period (calendar days after the assessment) |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Starter Service Contract | 0 | 100.00 | 30 |
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 0 | 100.00 | 30 |
| AHL Regional Account Contract | 0 | 250.00 | 30 |
| AHL Key Account Contract | 20 | 250.00 | 45 |
| AHL Global Account Contract | 25 | 500.00 | 45 |
| AHL Strategic Partner Contract | 30 | 500.00 | 60 |

## What each figure means
- **Assessment basis**: at term end, or quarterly prorated with a term-end true-up.
- **Tolerance**: the shortfall, as a percent of the commitment assessed, inside which nothing is charged.
- **Dead freight**: the charge per FEU of shortfall beyond the tolerance.
- **Quarterly carryover**: the excess lifting of a quarter that is carried into the next quarter's assessment, as a percent of the quarterly commitment.
- **Minimum assessment**: the shortfall amount below which no assessment is booked.
- **Payment period**: the calendar days after the assessment within which the shortfall is payable.

## Tier notes
- The three tiers assessed at term end have a carryover of 0, and the three tiers assessed quarterly have a carryover of 20, 25 and 30 %.
- The AHL Starter Service Contract has no tolerance margin (0 %).

## Converting the tolerance (hypothetical commitments)
| Tier | Hypothetical commitment assessed | Tolerance | Tolerance in FEU |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Standard Service Contract | 200 FEU | 5 % | 10 FEU |
| AHL Key Account Contract (one quarter) | 250 FEU | 10 % | 25 FEU |

Each FEU figure is the commitment assessed multiplied by the tolerance percent and divided by one hundred.
